text:

Poprzednie edycje gościły w SF, Nowym Jorku, Zurychu i Monachium.

Byłoby super Cię poznać - daj znać, czy znajdziesz czas, żeby do nas
dołączyć?

Pozdrawiam,
Kasia [SENDER]

*AI // ML // Computer Vision*

subject: [NAME] - ML Modeling - Fraud detection
text:

          [NAME], 

          We recently started working with Entrust/
          Onfido on their ML infra for risk decisioning, and I thought it might be relevant to [COMPANY]'s real-time fraud models.

          I'd love your feedback on what we've built - would you have 20 min Tue - Thu for a quick chat?

subject: Improving TRAM Accuracy
text:
Hi [NAME],

We've been working with teams like Reducto on real-world document parsing,
where OCR plus semantic structure often breaks down on edge cases like
tables, scans, handwriting, and especially checkboxes linked to specific
questions.

At Encord, our platform lets you collect, test, and label these tricky
document slices, including creating KeyPair associations between checkboxes
and their corresponding fields, critical for fintech compliance workflows
like TRAM evaluations.

Saw you're hiring for AI engineers, would you be open to a quick
conversation?
